instrument_rows.name: OVERFLOW-zps.replay.instrument.legoesm_hpg_vs_hpg_sco.rest
instrument_rows.staggering_and_reduction: legoESM momentum tendency at rest velocity (u=v=0: HPG only on this card) and the dynhpg.F90:340-390 replay are both U-face trends on the wet row; elementwise L-infinity

instrument_rows.name: OVERFLOW-zps.replay.instrument.legoesm_hpg_vs_hpg_sco.nemo_stage1_kaa
instrument_rows.staggering_and_reduction: legoESM momentum tendency at rest velocity (u=v=0: HPG only on this card) and the dynhpg.F90:340-390 replay are both U-face trends on the wet row; elementwise L-infinity

hpg_sco_replay.source: dynhpg.F90:340-390; domzgr_substitute.h90:131,139,145; domqco.F90:160; eos at live gdept (eosbn2.F90:1166)

freeze_stage_hpg_eta.one_variable: stage-2/3 eta time level: HPG r3t stretching AND the advection geometry it sets (live stage T/S)

freeze_stage_hpg_operands.one_variable: stage-2/3 EOS+HPG T/S/ssh time level AND the stage-eta advection geometry (two variables; see the split arms)

freeze_stage_hpg_tracers.one_variable: stage-2/3 EOS T/S time level (live stage eta)

legacy_stage_min_face_thickness.one_variable: stage transport face thickness: NEMO e3u_0*(1+r3u(Kmm)) (domqco.F90:219-222) vs min of the two stretched T cells

omit_stage_qco_factor.one_variable: qco weighting of the stage velocity update (stprk3_stg.F90:373-378)

omit_stage_vertical_up3.one_variable: vertical UP3 in each momentum-stage RHS

ownership.cancellation_warning: omission improves the final T residual but makes the direct instantaneous stage-1 u comparison much worse; the T movement is scale-compatible evidence for a residual contribution, not evidence that NEMO's required correction should be removed

P3_h2_is_refuted_as_the_stage3_owner.predicate: predicted stage-3 movement is < 0.01x the faithful kt=2 u residual, so the kt=2 u row does not clear

P3_h2_owns_stage1.predicate: faithful stage-1 baroclinic u < 1.3e-13 m/s and the omission reproduces the pre-fix residual

P3_h2_owns_stage2.predicate: faithful stage-2 baroclinic u < 1.4e-11 m/s and the omission reproduces the pre-fix residual
